title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E23 — George And Louise In A Bind
A burglar ties up George and Louise and gives them a night to remember in a special 90-minute episode. As they wait to be rescued, George and Louise re-live (by flashback) some of their most unforgettable and hilarious experiences.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E26 — Jenny's Thesis
Jenny Jefferson's thesis research on street gangs teaches her and her family a horrifying lesson in life...and death.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E1 — Louise's Painting
George riled by bare facts.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E2 — Homecoming-Part 1
Allan Willis, the 'white sheep' of the racially-mixed Willis family, arrives in town after several years absence and finds things just as he left them -- hostile -- in the first of a two-part story.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E3 — The Homecoming-Part 2
Allan sees through George's scheme to con him out of his newly inherited warehouse, so George directs his flim-flammery at an alternate target -- Louise -- in the conclusion of a two-part story.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E10 — Tim Conway, Stiller & Meara
Tim Conway's a burger clown and a baseball team coordinator; Stiller & Meara do a dentist skit and a police line-up.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E11 — Burns & Schreiber, The Fifth Dimension
Rev. Leroy visits a monastery; Burns & Schreiber improvise machines and Fifth Dimension members do a dating sketch with Flip.

Tamera's budding career as a lowdown blues singer is threatened when she gets "too happy" after her dream date asks her out!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E1 — When a Man Loves Two Women
Unbeknownst to the twins, they've both got a crush on the same guy: Roger!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E2 — You Are So Beautiful
Curiosity about their birth parents leads the twins, Ray, and Lisa on a quest to learn more about the girls' past.

title: Sister, Sister
description:

Tempted by the freedom of a new car, Tia and Tamera soon find themselves on a collision course with disaster when their car drops off a dock and into Lake Erie!

title: Sister, Sister
description:

Tamera learns she's never too old to be a daddy's girl when she finds herself jealous of the growing closeness between Ray and Tia.

title: Sister, Sister
description:

In a bid to boost their popularity at school, the twins try out for the cheerleading squad -- and Ray tries his hand at coaching them.

title: Sister, Sister
description:

When a new girl in school threatens Tia and Tamera's popularity, the twins join forces to win back their friends with the help of a music superstar.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E7 — Boy From the Hood
Tamera falls for Tia's childhood friend Darnell, who's all grown up and running with a fast crowd.

description:

description:

Webster helps the school janitor go back to being a magician.

title: Webster
description:

title: Webster
description:
S2 E8 — Moving On
Mystery and wonder are used to describe the new home George and Katherine are going to rent. This is a Victorian house replete with secret walls, openings, and more.

title: Webster
description:
S2 E9 — Thanksgiving Story
Webster, George, and Katherine are all trying to have a peaceful Thanksgiving. But things don't turn out the way they plan when George's aggressive father and Katherine's snobby mother arrive for Thanksgiving dinner.

title: Webster
description:
S2 E12 — Too Much Class
After Webster transfers to an advanced learning class, his grades start to slip.

S2 E17 — A Matter Of Choice
Lester wins a major contracting bid, which enables the Jenkins' to begin looking for their dream home when Lester discovers that the backers of the construction job are involved in South African investments.

S2 E18 — Happy Twentieth
Plans made by Mary (Marla Gibbs) and Lester (Hal Williams) to celebrate their 20th wedding anniversary result in disharmony when quarreling in-laws come to town.

S2 E19 — Toyland
Guest star Pee Wee Herman plays himself in this special episode in which he, Mary (Marla Gibbs), Lester (Hal Williams) and Sandra (Jackée) are held captive in a toy store and must resort to more than pop guns and bows and arrows to set themselves free.

S2 E20 — Far From The Tree
When Sandra (Jackée) cleans up her act and takes on a whole new identity for her visiting mother, special guest star Della Reese, she must split her personality to make another out-of-town guest, her 'HUNK DU JOUR,' happy as well.

S2 E21 — A Good Citizen
When Sandra (Jackée) alerts the police that she suspects her current love interest Justin (Sam Scarber) has stolen more than her heart, the detectives set up surveillance headquarters in the home of Mary (Marla Gibbs) and Lester (Hal Williams).
